works.title: Keep work reporting available after server restarts
works.intended_outcome: Recover interrupted reporting without losing or duplicating work milestones.

facts.statement: Keep session reporting available across server restarts without sending duplicate work updates.
Reconnect for each operation; check a lost write response by its update reference to avoid duplicate milestones.
Key-backed transports open a fresh server connection per operation, so an interrupted stream does not disable later status checks.
Local MCP round-trip tests recover discovery and status after connection failure; each failed submit is attempted once.
Publish the reviewed packages, then verify a normal work milestone reaches the approved project.

details.description: A disconnected response may follow successful capture; status recovery must precede any unchanged resend.
